body:
Issue #1037: makeGhWriter in packages/backlog-groom/lib/gh.mjs invokes gh issue view|comment|close|edit without --repo.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. Add parseRemoteRepo and verifyRepoEnv in packages/backlog-groom/lib/gh.mjs to extract origin host and owner/repo slug and reject mismatched GH_REPO or GH_HOST.
2. Update makeGhWriter in packages/backlog-groom/lib/gh.mjs to validate repo when supplied and pass --repo on every issue call.
3. Wire origin repo verification and GH_REPO/GH_HOST scrubbing into --apply in packages/backlog-groom/bin/backlog-groom.mjs.
4. Add unit and e2e tests in packages/backlog-groom/test/gh.test.mjs and packages/backlog-groom/test/apply-e2e.test.mjs.
Verify: node --test packages/backlog-groom/test/gh.test.mjs packages/backlog-groom/test/apply-e2e.test.mjs
title: backlog-groom: bind gh target to verified checkout and reject mismatched GH_REPO/GH_HOST (#1037)
